result.detail:
Open items for design.rtl.interface.tech_lead:
(1) Formal proof not submitted. Section 7 of the interface spec and section 6 of the microarchitecture call for an unbounded SymbiYosys proof (apb_regs.sby). The task lists only rtl_source and testbench as expected outputs, so no formal_spec file is submitted. The properties are in the RTL, but that verification requirement stays open until a .sby is submitted and formal.run and formal.cover pass.
(2) Failure-path testbench not produced. The microarchitecture plans apb_regs_tb_fail.v, which this task does not ask for; it is not produced.
(3) Testbench run requirements. The testbench uses # delays and edge waits, so Verilator needs --timing together with --binary or --main.
(4) Timescale. Neither file declares `timescale. This is deliberate, to avoid Verilator's TIMESCALEMOD mismatch.
(5) Verilator stopping on first error. If Verilator's default error limit stops on the first $error, a failing run ends without a verdict line. That still counts as a failed run.
